images.scene: Early morning on the island beach: five long dugout canoes are drawn up together on the sand, empty, their owners already gone inland out of sight; the wide bay and low green shore stretch beyond.
images.alt: Five empty dugout canoes drawn up together on a wide sandy beach at dawn.

images.scene: Seen from a hilltop lookout, about thirty islanders dance in wild gestures around a blazing fire on the beach where meat is being cooked; Robinson crouches on the brow of the hill watching through a small brass perspective glass.
images.alt: A crowd of islanders dance around a fire on the beach while a man watches from a hill through a spyglass.

images.scene: A lone barefoot captive plunges into a tidal creek and swims hard across the water with powerful strokes, escaping toward the near shore, while two pursuers hesitate at the far bank.
images.alt: A fleeing man swims across a tidal creek while two pursuers stop on the opposite bank.

images.scene: Robinson, having run downhill between the pursued and pursuers, swings the wooden stock of his musket and knocks the foremost pursuer to the ground on the open sands, a second pursuer with a bow standing farther off.
images.alt: A man clubs down a pursuer with the stock of his musket on a beach as another attacker stands beyond.

images.scene: The rescued man kneels on the sand before Robinson, kisses the ground, lays his head down and lifts Robinson's foot to place it upon his own head in a gesture of submission; Robinson stands over him with an open, encouraging hand.
images.alt: A kneeling man places another man's foot upon his own bowed head on the beach as a token of submission.

images.scene: Inside the fortified home enclosure, Robinson fits his new companion Friday with linen drawers, a goat-skin jerkin and a hare-skin cap, needle and cloth in hand, while Friday looks pleased at his new clothes.
images.alt: A man dresses his companion in homemade linen and animal-skin clothing inside a shelter.
